description: This Java class 'ProductFileManagerImpl' implements functionality for managing product images, including uploading images (original, resized, cropped), retrieving images, and deleting images within a sales management system. It interacts with image processing utilities and handles image configuration parameters.

classes.name: ProductFileManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of product file management, handling upload, retrieval, and deletion of product images with image processing and configuration.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Handles uploading a product image, processing cropping and resizing according to configuration, and managing the storage of original and resized images.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the product image either as original or with specified size.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a specific product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes images for a specific merchant store.
